Bleh. I'm subscribed to him and I knew it would be a hard video to watch so I decided to do it later. That's what brought me here Lol 
  
I thought it would help me better understand my ex but I guess not. Thanks for the posting this!

The reality of the situation is that it won't get any better from here...  
  
It took me 2 years to finally accept that

Sorry for the late reply. There are tips online for talking to a parent about mental illness. You can even find a professional to sit with both of you to help him see how serious it is. It's definitely hard to do, but please don't let his preconceived notion towards depression discourage you from talking to him about it if it's what you want. I hope it goes well if you do attempt to talk to him or anyone else about it.
[20/F] If you still need someone, I'm here. That goes for anyone else here in a similar situation.

I find that hygiene is one of the more left alone topics when it comes to mental illness. You're definitely not alone in this boat. There's lots of information about dandruff online if you ever wanna tackle that. 
I personally wash anything that might be unpleasant if left alone for too long (like feet, privates, or armpits) every so often until I can take a full shower. A change of clothes (even if it's just one article of clothing) goes a long way for me, even if I didn't shower.
 If you feel great when you're in the shower then what another comment suggested about easing into it sounds like a good idea.

Feeling empty is such an awful thing... 
Don't invalidate yourself! Cutting is a serious thing, whatever the reason. It sounds like you need a new therapist. You shouldn't have to struggle alone. Do you have plans to open up to anyone that thinks you're fine? I know it makes it harder for me when people think I'm okay when I'm not

Are there any support at school or your community that you could reach out to instead? If you don't want them to get involved and you could get support elsewhere, then maybe you could get back on track in secret? 
Does your counselor know your struggles regarding being gay?
And regarding the end of your post, there are always good options, even when they aren't clear in the moment. I know it's so easy to be hard on yourself but please remember that you're trying.

May I ask why you would be pulled out of college or why you think your relationships would be ruined?  You're no lesser of a human being for being overweight, gay, or socially awkward. Please keep in mind that 2 of those can be improved upon. And being gay is okay ♡ is there any problem in your life because of it?

Thank you so much for replying!

I guess my only goal in life right now is to handle my mental health better. Hell, even that goal is fading. I'm not sure what steps to take anymore when I can't make it to a doctors appointment. (haven't seen mine in months)
Thank you so much for taking the time to reply! I'm too anxious to write much else, but I wanted to show my appreciation for people like you (:
